opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The appeal and writ of error are dismissed on the authority of § 237 (a) of the Judicial Code as amended by the act of February 13, 1925 (43 Stat. 936, 937), for lack of jurisdiction. Treating the appeal and writ of error as an application for certiorari the same is denied.
